description: A standard case-study request must produce a situation/approach/result draft that carries the one supplied metric, names the pillar verbatim, and closes with the roof line.

input.situation: A multi-entity group could not get finance, operations and commercial to agree on one number for the same question.
input.approach: Canvas Intelligence rebuilt the consolidation on Microsoft Fabric with a written reconciliation commitment.
input.result: a written 99.5% reconciliation-to-source commitment, with any variance treated as a Severity-1 incident

rubric.criterion: Roof line closes the case study
rubric.condition: The last non-empty line of the case study is exactly the string: Your Data. Delivered.
The case study contains the exact string Finance-grade trust, matching the pillar supplied in the input.
The output contains the literal substring 99.5%, the number supplied as the result metric.

notes: Anchored to positioning.md section 5 (messaging house roof line) and prompt.md structure rules 3 and 6.
